phase_reset_credit.value: summon golem group; link shared health after 5s; schedule first recharge at 10s
set IN_PROGRESS; clear Static Shock/Poison Bomb/Arcane Annihilator/Flamethrower worldstates; summon Nefarius heroic; zone golems; activate queue
activated aura expiry casts Shutting Down; inactive applies Powered Down and makes golem not selectable; queue recharge continues
constructs disengage/despawn; boss state FAIL; raid debuffs removed; summons despawned; controller evades
controller calls _JustDied; constructs disengage; debuffs removed; instance forwards Omnotron DONE to generic Nefarius credit
base boss/construct IDs map into instance data; loader calls AddSC_boss_omnotron_defense_system; historical encounter row is 1027/42180
